groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are Fifth Judicial District and Circuit judges serving Hot Springs with Big Horn and Washakie (Bobbi Overfield, Ed Luhm / Edward G. Luhm) and the Park-seat judges (Bill Simpson, Joey Darrah), from official court roster titles already used in the official Park, Washakie, and Big Horn histories. Official 2026 Hot Springs canvass retention for Judge Bobbi Overfield is YES 1,654 / NO 261. Official 2026 CHC BURNINGHAM is the statewide Chancery Court retention already in the shared terms, not a Fifth Judicial District circuit office.
